text:
lena: heads up — internal candidate (Anita) is moving from IC Sr Eng to Eng Manager role in a different org. offer shows same 'Senior' comp band and title as IC because of band compression, but hiring manager requests Manager title + one-time transition bonus and preservation of tenure for 401k vesting/pto accrual. do we need a formal exception for vesting preservation + bonus?
marc: internal transfers usually preserve service date for benefits, but manager title with same band is fine. one-time cash transition bonuses > $5k need comp approval. preservation of vesting is HR/payroll/legal combo.
taylor: want to be careful w/ equity cliff/RSU schedules — if this is a promotion we often accelerate first tranche. what's the ask amount for transition bonus?
lena: hiring mgr (Rick) asking $8k one-time, and explicit note that Anita would lose 2 weeks of vesting if start date resets to new org effective date. manager wants written confirmation that vesting service date stays 2019-04-01.
rick: yes — please confirm quickly. candidate signed verbal; team wants to publish formal offer by EOD Friday. risk of losing candidate if we stall.
priya: legal/compliance: preserving service date is allowed but must be recorded in the transfer memo and payroll code. any cash bonus > threshold requires comp committee routing and exec sponsor if >10% of base. also need manager to confirm there are no salary compression issues downstream.
hr-bot: checklist reminder: for internal transfers include: transfer memo, new offer letter, payroll code changes, benefits preservation form, comp exception ticket (if needed).
marc: route: create comp exception ticket for $8k bonus and note promotion status. tag @finance for payroll impact and @priya for compliance. include justification + candidate retention risk.
taylor: also attach current equity grant schedule and proposed treatment (accelerate first vest or leave unchanged).
lena: action items: 1) rick to attach equity schedule & retention rationale 2) marc to open comp exception ticket 3) finance to confirm payroll adjustment and vesting preservation steps 4) priya to pre-clear legal language for memo.
marc: opened ticket #PO-8473 and assigned to @priya @finance. pasted candidate ID and transfer memo draft.
finance: got it, will confirm payroll steps. preserving service date requires HR form + GL mapping; i'll upload impact calc by 1400.
priya: will review memo and draft approval wording. if committee approves bonus, we need written exec sponsor. i can loop in Cal when packet is ready.
lena: thanks all. rick — pls post the equity schedule here when ready. :pray:
